ValidationRule.description: Non-admins may only move Status to Cancelled or Paused (cleanup values), and may never create an Agreement already marked Completed. Completed feeds the signed-agreement rollups and dashboards. System Administrator bypasses.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", OR( AND( ISCHANGED(Status__c), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Cancelled")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Paused")) ), AND( ISNEW(), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Completed") ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You can only change Agreement Status to Cancelled or Paused. For any other status change, contact a System Administrator.
